summary: Sky Harbour Group Corporation filed a Form 8-K on August 21, 2026, disclosing a Stock Purchase Agreement with M-COR Capital LLC for a registered direct offering of 1,000,000 Class A common shares at $10.00 per share, roughly $10 million gross, expected to close on or before August 26, 2026, subject to customary conditions. The filing, under Items 7.01 and 8.01, is a routine capital-raising disclosure rather than a special situation. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or regulatory clock is stated; watch for pricing relative to market and dilution/overhang on the NYSE-listed SKYH shares and warrants.
